liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Keep Your Day Job** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Attendee enjoyed this first-time song; later the band overplayed it, perhaps explaining why it was never studio recorded; Reviewer remembers a very jivey Day Job followed by Man Smart (Woman Smarter), with Brent especially hot [14][18][29]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Attendee found this song, new to the band's live repertoire that night, very cool; The band's jazzy, bluesy instrumental interplay makes this a standout, taking listeners through the seedy side of LA [14][20][29]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Jerry stretches out and reaches several peaks in this version [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-08-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106166.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 157 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1982-08-28.158651.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 159 min [2]
- **gd82-08-28.sbd.lai.2333.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4.54/5 by 28 [7]. Said about its sound: Good sound quality, but recording levels run somewhat low; The recording sounds very good, with plenty of bottom end [15][21]
- **gd1982-08-28.sbd.lai.tetzeli.fix-2333.34933.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 152 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [9]
- **gd1982-08-28.set2.fob.nak300.fleishner.feinberg.79350.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 14 songs; 89 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has some tape hiss, notably in Space, and distortion especially in the second half of set two [12]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Ken Babs [1]
- Reviewer calls the area Kesey Country and suggests the fair normally happens the weekend after July 4th [15]
- Reviewer snuck in, slept by the train tracks, and sat on hay bales with crew; crowds rushed in when gates opened [16]
- Two stages and heavy dust from dancing marked the day [16]
- Dancers kicked up lots of dust, and hash cookies were sold on the grounds [18]
- Show took place in the fairgrounds' fields and parking lots; rain the day before gave way to a hot, beautiful day [19]
- Hippie parents and children ran around with rose garlands and streamers in their hair [19]
- Reviewer helped put up the U.F.O. tent, and Ken Kesey came over to shake his hand [22]
- Billed as Springfield Creamery's Second Decadenal Field Trip, held at the Oregon Country Fair grounds [1]
- For other strong 1982 shows, reviewer suggests 05-22-82, 07-28/29-82 and 12-30-82 [21]
- The previous Dupree's Diamond Blues was on 4/14/78 [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-08-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106166.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Maxell XLIIS-90) [1]
- **gd1982-08-28.158651.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; 3 x Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5; Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [2]. Also: A Nakamichi 700 source from Bob Wagner patches the end of Althea, the crowd before It's All Over Now, and a bit of Space [2]
- **gd82-08-28.sbd.lai.2333.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1982-08-28.sbd.lai.tetzeli.fix-2333.34933.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Mike Lai and Bill Tetzeli; source: sbd>>cassette master>>cassette>>cdr>>WAV>>shn>>wav>>flac [9]. Also: Fix of SHN 2333: seamless CD 2 to 3 transition, tracks split, converted to FLAC, sector boundaries verified [9]
- **gd1982-08-28.set2.fob.nak300.fleishner.feinberg.79350.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Dave Fleishner; transferred by Alex Ford; source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM 300s w/ CP4 shotgun capsules > ?? > master audience cassette > cassette (Maxell XLII-S 90) [12]. Also: Ken Babbs's introduction is patched in from SHN ID 2333 [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oregon Country Fair Site - August 28, 1982](https://www.dead.net/show/august-28-1982) [30]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [GRATEFUL DEAD Poster 1982 - Springfield Creamery Field Trip Concert Oregon | #1803070107](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-poster-1982-springfield-1803070107) [31]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1982-08-28 Sat Oregon Country Fairgrounds, Veneta, OR](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1404511337574/grateful-dead-1982-08-28-sat-oregon) [32]
- Poster by Oregon County Fair: [Grateful Dead Vintage Concert Poster from Oregon County Fair, Aug 28, 1982 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/posters-handbills-and-postcards/grateful-dead/poster/OCF820828.html) [33]
